title: Lecturer on Education Faculty Co-Chair, Arts and Learning Concentration
bio: Louisa Penfold is co-chair of the Arts and Learning Concentration. Her research and practice focus on contemporary art, early childhood education, and play-based learning across schools, museums, and public spaces.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
